item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.

item.title: Editorial: Schools should employ bus stop scofflaw camera
item.description: One of the most critical rules of the road concerns the safety of schoolchildren, and the risk posed when motorists ignore the flashing light warning that precedes a school bus coming to a stop. As previously reported, many of the state’s police departments have posted notices on social media about the consequences of not stopping for school buses. item.title: Ask the Psychic: How can I find peace within me and let go of the noise?
item.description: DEAR BONNIE: I am having a hard time discovering my true self. I want to let go of the fears and ego-driven external noise, however I am not sure how and if I can let go of the outside noise of the evening news and the chaos all around me. I want to let go and find peace within me.
